env.name: lbf_9x9
env.notes: Approximately replicates OMIS's (Jing et al., NeurIPS 2024) own LBF setup for a population-replication experiment: 9x9 grid, 2 agents, 5 food, full observability, horizon=50 (their own horizon_per_ep_dict['lbf']), force_coop=False with stochastic per-food levels (matches their actual gym.make('Foraging-9x9-2p-5f-v2') -- no '-coop' suffix -- see module docstring; an earlier version of this config used force_coop=True + different_levels=True, a fixed-split approximation that does not match). Not a registered preset (see scripts/gen_omis_lbf_mep_config.py); not part of the tiered benchmark matrix.
